research_status: 2014-2020 is disclosed iterative Development; 2021-2023 remains unopened until the fixed Development gate passes
economic_hypothesis: A locally bullish PIT industry can sustain a second markup only when the stock has accumulated gradually, a completed non-limit demand bar escapes the recent ceiling, the next 15 percent price corridor has little completed historical occupancy, and both broad-market and industry participation are expanding again. Low overhead supply and renewed sponsorship must both be present; either alone is insufficient.
independence: No collapse-gap, true-gap repair, V6, V7, V26, or V27 event identity is used. This is a non-gap bull participation strategy.

binding_conditions.PIT_LOCAL_INDUSTRY_BULL: PIT industry has at least 10 members; median ret20 and ret60 are positive; positive-ret20 and positive-ret60 shares both exceed 50 percent
binding_conditions.DISTRIBUTED_ACCUMULATION: strictly prior 20-session return is 5 to 25 percent; at least 60 percent of prior sessions are positive; maximum absolute prior daily return is below 7 percent; downside/upside turnover ratio is at most 0.65
binding_conditions.ACTIVE_DEMAND_BREAKOUT: completed non-limit return is 2 to 7 percent, close location at least 75 percent, close above the strictly prior 20-session high, and turnover is 1.2 to 2.5 times the strictly prior 20-session median
binding_conditions.LOW_INVENTORY_TARGET_CORRIDOR: exactly 126 completed, hard-valid, same-coordinate-lineage sessions precede the signal; no more than 10 intersect [signal close, 1.15 times signal close]
binding_conditions.RENEWED_MARKET_AND_INDUSTRY_DEMAND: current market and PIT-industry positive-ret20 breadth are each at least 70 percent and each exceeds its exact 10-market-session lag by at least 10 percentage points; current and lag coverage are market at least 200 and industry at least 10

cooldown: more than 20 market sessions since the prior raw identical stock event
entry: first legal daily open after the completed signal, within three market sessions
profit_target: +15 percent gross, standing only from the first T+1 session
time_stop: H15 decision, then next legal open

chronology.forward_check: 2021-01-01 through 2023-12-31, opened once only if Development passes
chronology.tail_read: 2024-01-01 through 2024-03-31 may be read only to resolve legal exits of 2023 entries
